# DuelScreen

## Purpose
The duel overlay over the gameplay board: the opponent search, the 3-2-1-GO countdown, the race bar with both runs, and the win or lose banner.

## Concepts
duel screen, ghost race, countdown, race bar, versus, düello, DuelScreenView
